_comment: Core defaults. Every organisation inherits this and overrides only what it needs in orgs/<id>/config.json (objects merge; arrays such as `agents` are replaced).

captions.aagbi: AAGBI Safety Guideline: Management of Severe Local Anaesthetic Toxicity (2010, archived).
captions.asra: ASRA Local Anaesthetic Systemic Toxicity Checklist, v1.1 (2020).

alt.aagbi: AAGBI 2010 severe local anaesthetic toxicity guideline
alt.asra: ASRA 2020 local anaesthetic systemic toxicity checklist

text.proteinBinding: Consider reducing doses in low protein binding states: neonates and infants, pregnancy, malnutrition, low BMI or low albumin, liver or kidney disease, sepsis or critical illness, burns, acidosis.
text.footer: Decision-support only. Verify all doses against local policy and clinical judgement. Intravascular injection can cause toxicity below maximum doses. Consider dose reduction in the elderly.
text.defaultLimits: Default limits are commonly quoted reference values within UK practice. Verify against local guidance and edit as required.
text.defaultLimitsShort: Default limits are commonly quoted reference values within UK practice.
text.neonate: Protein binding is reduced in neonates; consider reducing dose by up to 50%. Verify doses against local guidance.
text.infant: Consider reducing dose. Verify doses against local guidance.
text.airwayGuideline: 9 mg/kg is the DAS guideline maximum for awake tracheal intubation (ATI), capped at 700 mg. Airway lidocaine used is subtracted from this pool.
text.disclaimer: Disclaimer: UI entirely vibecoded in Claude Sonnet 5.5, based on a functional excel based applet. This calculator has been stress tested and double checked for accuracy.{contact}
